# Case `C02_no_segregation`

**Category:** control (Controls with numerical kill criteria)
**Source:** synthetic · **Split:** holdout

## Why it is in the matrix

The negative control: the segregation number set to zero, which makes the Gray-Thornton equation degenerate to pure tracer advection. Any size sorting produced by the solver is then leaking in from somewhere it should not.

## Expected behaviour

Every lot in the pile still carries exactly the coarse fraction of the truck it came from. The aggregate toe-minus-apex delta is not expected to be zero: different dumps carry different size distributions and land in different places, so the geometry alone produces a small spatial pattern. Measured at Sr = 0 it is about -0.01, against about +0.44 at Sr = 1, so the solver contribution is two orders of magnitude larger than the geometric one.

## Kill criterion

> A lot whose coarse fraction differs from its source dump's by more than 1e-12 at Sr = 0 means the solver is modifying the size split when it has been switched off

This is the statement that turns the case from a demonstration into a test. It says, in advance, what
result would mean the code is wrong, and the release gate fails the bake when it is violated.

## Configuration

| parameter | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| `stacking` | `chevron` | the deposition path over the pad |
| `reclaim` | `fullface` | which cells the machine engages and how deep it reaches |
| `n_passes` | 24 | stacker passes, that is layers: the N of the 1/N bound |
| `sr` | 0.0 | the Gray-Thornton segregation number; 0 is a passive tracer |
| `repose_deg` | 37.0 | the imposed angle of repose of the fine species |
| `repose_coarse_deg` | 37.0 | the coarse species; a positive difference is Makse |
| `structure` | `stationary` | the autocorrelation structure of the incoming stream |
| `range_t` | 4000 t | the practical range of the input variogram, in tonnes |
| `n_dumps` | 320 | truck loads in the build |
| `reclaim_rate` | 1.0 | tonnes reclaimed per tonne stacked |
| `cut_tonnes` | 900 t | the parcel size the plant receives |
| pad | 64 x 24 cells at 3.0 m | 192 by 72 metres |

## Reproduce it

```bash
python data-pipeline/run.py C02_no_segregation --output build/check --band-seeds 5
```

Omit `--output` only for an intentional canonical release bake. Everything about this case is a pure
function of its parameters and the seed, so two runs produce a byte-identical trace.
